QUOTE: "`MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` has default state `off`, declared at `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`." and "`MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` is also `off` by default (`mbedtls_config.h:2196`)."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states both threading macros are off by default in the shipped mbedtls_config.h, so a default build defines neither.
